products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates the Arena AI platform at lmarena.ai, which the site describes as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models. The platform supports crowdsourced, real-world evaluation of language, image, and code models, and user conversations are disclosed to relevant AI providers and may be made public to support community research. The site also notes that conversations are used for automated evaluation, in which prompts are sent to AI providers at a later time to score and compare their models.

The organization's tracked product, listed as LMSYS Arena Models, is categorized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use. LMSYS is recorded as a nonprofit organization. No litigation, patent filings, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
